lastCompletedStory.title: Make the auditor BLOCK on the -q + -L/-l oracle antipattern

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a new sub-paragraph to section C item 9 (oracle health) in BOTH .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md, right after the existing 'no oracle at all' critical-finding sentence: a `file-assert` oracle whose grep invocation combines `-q` with `-L`/`-l` in ANY order/spacing (-Lq, -qL, -L -q, -l -q, -lq) is self-nullifying and must be a critical BLOCK finding, naming the replacement `! grep -q PATTERN file` (absence) / `grep -q PATTERN file` (presence). Re-embedded via `bun run embed-vendor`; extended the existing 'templatesContents — oracle enforcement in auditor prompt (US-002)' describe block in test/embedded.test.ts (note: that describe-block name predates this PRD, from an earlier unrelated US-002 story, but the topic still matches so it was extended not renamed). Raised test/embedded.test.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling 659->666 (actual line count via content.split('\n').length) with a dated _ref note citing CAM-309/US-002. Both US-001 and US-002 of this PRD touched the same src/vendor/_generated.ts and the same _ref chain in file-size-budget.json; each story reran embed-vendor and appended its own _ref entry rather than reusing the prior one.
